Notes.Text:
This update for google-osconfig-agent fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-63209: github.com/klauspost/compress: signed integer overflow in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass
  repeat index validation and cause a process crash (bsc#1283672).

Changes for google-osconfig-agent:

- Update to version 20260928.01
 * scalibr linux new metadata support (#1038)
- from version 20260928.00
 * Fix failing to report REBOOTING state during postPatchReboot
 due to context canceled for Windows VMs (#1055)
- from version 20260923.03
 * Fix os/snap extractor usage (#1053)
- Update to version 20260918.01
 * bump grpc package to new version (#1057)
- from version 20260918.00
 * bump some dependencies across few modules (#1056)
- Remove stale Go module version overrides in _service file

Vulnerabilities.Description: compress provides various compression algorithms. Prior to version 1.18.7, a signed integer overflow vulnerability in s2.NewDict() allows an attacker to bypass repeat index validation by supplying a dictionary with a uvarint-encoded repeat value exceeding MaxInt64. When Dict.Encode() is subsequently called, the overflowed negative repeat value causes an out-of-bounds memory access via unsafe.Pointer arithmetic, crashing the process with SIGSEGV. This issue has been patched in version 1.18.7.
